43c4b5b1: Quit if no input
59241448: Increment $data utilities index (DQ) to next script level. DQ is a scratch array to store utility data across script lines.
11512f2e: Branch to the next script line
98232b97: If the script line is defined for the current DQ level, execute Print/Read and Transfer (Branch) lines
5ad8277a: If input is null, branch to next script level (A) if DV does not contain 'R' (Required), quit if DV is null or data exceeds allowed length, otherwise branch to next level.
05646c02: If input starts with '?', go to Question/Help section (QS). If input starts with '^', execute D xref and branch to ^DIE17
4295cc14: If input is '@', execute D xref and branch to Z^DIE2 for FileMan options
2c2a2d49: If input is blank space, DV allows LAYGO, and a default value exists for the current user/file/field, set input to the default value and display it unless DV contains 'D' or 'S'

d5c1ebdc: If DV is null, branch to M^DIE17 for standard syntax help. If DV contains 'V', branch to ^DIE3 for Value syntax help. If DV does not contain 'S', execute ProcessHelp code. If a transform exists for the current file/field, execute it. Set Y=X and execute any INPUT transform defined in DIC('S'). If no DB node exists for the current script level, display the transformed value and branch to V (Validator).
0cf4f950: ;Check if the entry passes the screen (DIC('S')) and quit if not.
0d967a6c: ;Write the remainder of YS (starting from DG) if DB(DQ) is undefined, and set X to the part of YS before the first colon.
2b3bbd73: ;If 'P' is in DV, set DIC and DIC(0) appropriately for a lookup/add, and do the lookup/add; set X to the IEN of the match or new entry, and set DIC to the input variables.
cdd90703: ;If 'N' is not in DV, go to label V; otherwise, do the DATA type input transform and kill X if the decimal portion is longer than 24 characters.

264e499e: ;If the second parameter of DV indicates a numeric comma-piece and X contains a decimal point and DQ(DQ) doesn't end in '$': Remove any leading 0's after the decimal point, and remove any trailing 0's after the decimal point. If what's left after the decimal point is blank and X contained a decimal point originally, set X to an integer.
5034d273: Save the value of X in YS, then kill YS after executing whichever code is referenced by the XECUTABLE string value.

040afe88: If X is defined and not equal to the up-arrow, store its value in the global array DG at the index DW. If DV contains the letter 'd', also store the value of X in ^DISV for the current user. Then go to the label A.
3a57a506: If the invalid data behavior is defined for the current field, write the alarm character and branch to the error handling code in routine DIE17.

854ec884: ;If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute O subroutine. If X is not '@' go to RD, if DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@' go to A, if X is '@' go to X. Set X to Y and go to N.
bfe549a4: Execute expression and jump to label RP on computable cross-reference.

54092b1b: If the data is a file with a pointer and the pointer file exists, set X to the pointer file number and Y to the .01 field of the pointed-to entry, and set DG to the global root of the pointer file. Then loop back to label R.

3a17b1ef: If the data is a file with a MUMPS cross-reference subscript reference and the referenced global exists, set X to the file number of the referenced global and Y to the .01 field of the referenced entry. If the pointed-to file has a .01 field definition, set DG to the global root of the pointed-to file and X to the specifier code. Then loop back to label R.
ed386f3d: If DG contains 'D', execute the data dictionary utility. If DG contains 'S', extract the piece of X following the piece containing Y and set Y to that value.
7b4d68b1: Check if X is null or not. If not null, quit or go to next node based on value of DC.
8554765f: If DV does not contain 'I' or '#', go to RD.
713dc25e: Execute code for Edit which-file-line. If X exists, go to RD, else go to PR.
ef20c35a: Quit.
d4463b78: Set variable names and initialize DQ to 1.
0723d976: Set field properties for field 10.06 SIGNED BY.
98d13581: Set DU for reference to FILE(200,
bcb94ea8: Go to RE label.
4e31ebb6: Dummy label X1. Quit.
01b04115: If DG exists, call F^DIE17 and DE subroutines. Set Y and DQ. Execute X2. If Y is null or Y=U, go to A. Otherwise set X, DIC(0) and DW. Go to OUT^DIE17.
58dd01cb: If X is blank, set the 5th piece of the DT node to blank, set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED', and set Y to '@2'.
1bce63c6: Quit.

bdc91aab: If DG is defined, call the DIE17 utility to update the file. Set Y to the up-arrow character and DQ to 3. Call the X3 subroutine. If Y is undefined or Y is the up-arrow, branch to label A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to the OUT^DIE17 label.
35f45f9f: Set DGJTST to 'SIGNED'.
4b825f3b: Quit.
